incidents.name: Increased Errors with Project Lifecycle Operations in US-West-2

incident_updates.body:
We continue to work with our upstream provider as they investigate the ongoing incident affecting US-West-2. There are no additional updates at this time, and Project Lifecycle operations remain impacted. Currently active projects remain unaffected.

We will provide another update in 2 hours, or sooner if additional information becomes available.

All Project Lifecycle operations are currently impacted by an upstream provider incident affecting EC2 instances in US-West-2.

Currently up and active projects are unaffected and remain healthy. New project creation, unpauses, restore actions, project size changes, restarts and other lifecycle operations may encounter errors.

We advise against taking these actions in US-West-2 at this time while we work with our provider to resolve this issue.

We will be carrying out a scheduled maintenance window to perform internal platform improvements and upgrades.

Maintenance Window:

• Start time: 03:00 UTC on July 2, 2026

• End time: 04:00 UTC on July 2, 2026

Impact:

• Various platform operations will be delayed during this window

• These may include project creation and initial configuration/setup

• All affected operations will be rescheduled at the end of the window to ensure no operation is dropped
